instruction: Hide all the docks and also disable the tab bar in GIMP.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully hid GIMP docks by navigating Windows menu and clicking Hide Docks in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Windows menu), toggle UI visibility settings, understands dock/tab/window concepts.
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed the agent can toggle GIMP UI settings. This harder variation requires toggling TWO settings (hide docks + disable tab bar), testing multi-step menu navigation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding docks (Windows > Hide Docks) AND disabling the tab bar (Windows > Show Tabs uncheck). Custom metric checks both settings in sessionrc with 0.5 partial credit each.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads GIMP sessionrc file which stores UI visibility state like hide-docks and show-tabs settings.
Postconfig correctly quits GIMP with Ctrl+Q to force sessionrc to be written to disk before reading.
Metric correctly parses GIMP's Lisp-like config format by stripping parentheses and splitting on whitespace.
Both instruction requirements (hide docks + disable tab bar) are verified with equal partial credit (0.5 each).
Metric parameter handling is correct: 'rule' parameter receives the rules dict directly when expected.type='rule'.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider increasing postconfig sleep from 0.5s to 1-2s to ensure GIMP fully quits and writes sessionrc before the getter reads it.
The pyautogui.hotkey call uses a list argument pyautogui.hotkey(['ctrl', 'q']) - verify this works correctly vs pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'q') with separate args.
If GIMP prompts to save unsaved images on Ctrl+Q, the quit may not complete and sessionrc may not be written. Consider adding a 'Don't Save' button click in postconfig as a safeguard.
